operationTimedOut: The request was stopped after {{minutes}} minutes. Records already sent are unaffected — refresh to see where the queue stands.
outboxDesc: Records queued for the Shared Health Record, newest first.
sendQueuedHelp: Sends records that are waiting, without waiting for the scheduled task. Records are handed to OpenFn, which delivers them to the SHR — their status becomes Sent once delivery is confirmed.
shrAdminDescription: Clinical records captured here are queued and sent to the national Shared Health Record by a scheduled task. Use this page to send queued records immediately and to retry records that failed.
shrScheduleNote: Records are also sent automatically by the SHR Sync Task, on the interval configured in Administration → Manage Scheduler.
